title: AI murder mysteries (v1)
author: happy_pablo
selftext:
Hey guys! I recently started working on a side project called Open cases. It’s a murder-mystery game where you interrogate AI characters, hunt for contradictions, and try to solve different cases

Link: https://www.babayagalabs.com 

The main thing i want to test in the coming weeks is the core experience of such a UGC platform where you can come in and build your own playable mysteries. If you try it, i’d love to get some feedback on:

\- What felt fun vs confusing in the current interrogation gameplay? 

\- How can i improve the UX for “create your own mystery” so that it can create coherent mysteries?

Quick heads up, the current mysteries aren’t well crafted (most have some plot holes/inconsistencies)
